name: com.tomergoldst.networkrequestqueue.RequestQueueWakeUpReceiver
description: The NetworkRequestQueue SDK by Tomer Goldstein calls this Receiver when a timed retry for a failed queued request is due. It starts the Service that tries the saved requests again.
disableEffect: Requests waiting for a timed retry may remain unsent, which can stop an app feature that relies on them from completing.
